capabilities: Send a line or selected lines to OpenTodo as tasks
Parse checkbox and quick-add task syntax into dates, priorities and labels
Show a confirmation sheet before sending
Link each task back to its source note and repair links after renames
Sync a vault folder with OpenTodo in two directions
disambiguation: Not a task manager inside Obsidian; it sends tasks to a self-hosted OpenTodo server and syncs a folder with it.
extras: The plugin does nothing until connected to a server; the API token is kept in Obsidian's device storage rather than the vault's data.json, so each device needs its own token. The README's table of manual folder-sync runs on real devices lists every run as not yet run.
problem: Turning a line in a note into a task on an external task server, and keeping a folder of task files in step with it, is manual work in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: with the files and rules of ot vault

requires.name: OpenTodo API token with Full scope

summary: Sends note lines to a self-hosted OpenTodo server as tasks that link back to the note, and keeps a vault folder in two-way sync.
